about: What a recipe's `wakes` list may say, copied from what the engine's wake primitive accepts, so a recipe that passes here is a wake the engine takes. The engine reads `wakes` from every Workshop row, a listed recipe row included, and a Workshop row's wake is off until the person switches it on; one malformed item refuses every row's wakes, which is why each is checked here before it ships. A wake is { id, on: { <one cause>: { ...its fields } }, budget: { <dimension>: whole number }, input: { start_at: <step id>, ...input_schema fields } }: exactly the engine's declaration, nothing added. `start_at` in its input is the step a woken run starts at. Adding a cause is adding a row to `causes` once the engine takes it; a field shape is one of text (a non-empty string), zone (an IANA time zone name the time zone database knows; a repeat in a zone keeps its wall-clock time), whole (a whole number from 0), positive (a whole number above 0) or strings (an object whose values are strings). A field may carry its own `refusal` words. A field's `in` names a list in this file its value must be one of; `keys_in` names an object in this file whose entry under the value of field `by` lists the keys allowed; `only_with` names a field that must be present for this one to be. The budget must hold at least `least_budget` (the engine's run cost plus its reserved run time, below which a firing is never funded) and at most the ledger its cause draws from (a firing above it is never funded either).

read_from: src/wake.rs: enum On (record, time, arrival, host_event; deny_unknown_fields) and Waker::declared (record resource not the wake book, time at_ms or every_ms above 0 with from_ms and zone only beside every_ms and a zone the time zone database does not name refused, arrival source non-empty, host_event match values strings, budget keys only ledger dimensions, input an object, ids unique per row)
src/wake/workshop_runner.rs: WAKES_FIELD, the row field the engine reads wakes from
product/wake.json: ledgers, draws, run_cost, wall_dimension, max_wakes
product/tool-runs.json: deadline_ms (the time reserved for every run)
product/host-events.json: kinds and their payload fields
src/storage/s2h_resources.json: own-records, the resource a person's records live in

causes.meaning: A record of the person's changes: of one kind, or whose id starts with prefix, in the resource named.

A time comes: once at at_ms, or every every_ms counted from from_ms (0 when absent); with a zone, from_ms's wall-clock time in that zone moved by every_ms of wall-clock time, so a daylight saving change keeps it. A missed slot fires once.

fields.refusal: must name a time zone the time zone database knows, for example Europe/Lisbon.

causes.meaning: Something arrives from the source named (an incoming event, or another run's arrive effect).
The computer reports something of a declared kind, whose payload equals every field of match.
